hypotheses.O1_high_active_ood_fidelity: Frozen native-coefficient core-32 reaches at least 0.40 median downstream fidelity on high-active sites in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.O2_high_active_specificity: Frozen native-coefficient own core-32 exceeds the wrong-category core by at least 0.20 on high-active sites in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.O3_adaptive_retention: Frozen core-32 retains at least 75% of adaptive per-site top-32 fidelity on high-active sites in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.O4_random_active_transfer: Frozen core-32 reaches at least 0.25 median downstream fidelity on random-active sites in each OOD corpus.
hypotheses.O5_refit_membership_specificity: With coefficients refit to the exact residual write, own core-32 exceeds the wrong-category core by at least 0.20 on high-active sites in each OOD corpus.
